tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read the user-selected AI browsing mode and connection state.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List available browsing windows with titles, focus, selection and tabs. Private windows and windows outside the user-selected mode are excluded.

tools.name: activate_window
tools.description: Select and present a browsing window. Subsequent calls without tab_id or window_id use this window until another is selected.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List tabs available in the user-selected mode. Optionally filter by window_id. Private tabs are excluded.

window_id.description: Window ID from list_windows. Omit to list tabs in all available windows.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a tab in the selected window, or an explicit window_id, and wait for loading.

url.description: An http://, https:// or about:blank URL.

window_id.description: Window ID from list_windows. Omit to use the selected window, or the current browsing window before one is selected.

tools.name: activate_tab
tools.description: Select a tab available in the current mode.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Request normal tab closure, including unsaved-change prompts.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab and wait for loading.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

url.description: An http:// or https:// URL, or about:blank.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back in this tab's history.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Go forward in this tab's history.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Read visible page text and element references, with a viewport PNG by default. Frame contents can be operated using screenshot coordinates.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move the distinct AI co-cursor to an element or viewport coordinate.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

ref.description: Element reference from the latest snapshot. Alternatively supply viewport x and y.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Send a real left click to an element or viewport coordinate.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

ref.description: Element reference from the latest snapshot. Alternatively supply viewport x and y.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Insert Unicode text using real browser input. Optionally click a referenced field first; replace selects existing field text first.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

ref.description: Element reference from the latest snapshot. Alternatively supply viewport x and y.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page using a real wheel event. Optional viewport coordinates choose the scroll area.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key, optionally with Control, Shift, Alt or Meta, e.g. Enter, Tab, ArrowDown, Control+A.

tab_id.description: Tab ID from list_tabs. Omit to use the current tab in the window chosen with activate_window (or the current browsing window before one is selected).

key.description: Named browser key or one ASCII letter/digit, with optional modifiers.
